# Debrief: Argo CD, cert-manager, Envoy, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Istio, Kubernetes

These clips cover Argo CD GitOps pitfalls and tooling, cert-manager's Gateway API role amid Ingress Nginx deprecation, Istio's sidecar-to-ambient evolution, and Prometheus-to-OpenTelemetry collector migration lessons. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 14:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=851s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Ingress Nginx is archived, pushing teams toward Gateway API; cert-manager users relying on the Ingress annotation are affected, and its Gateway API integration dates back to 2021. ([Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s))
2. Argo CD maintainer calls writing many individual Applications an anti-pattern; one ApplicationSet can replace 50 apps across clusters, and the Helm sandwich packaging pattern is also called an anti-pattern. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s); [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 12:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=740s))
3. Moving to the OTel collector was near one-to-one from Prometheus service discovery config; batch processor early and memory limiter help avoid collector OOM kills. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 14:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=851s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit Certificates issued via the cert-manager Ingress annotation and plan a Gateway API migration, noting experimental feature enablement and plugin needs for tools like Argo Rollouts. ([Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
- [ ] Review Argo CD setup for individual Application manifests per cluster and consolidate them into ApplicationSets, planning how clusters are categorized. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s))
- [ ] When trying an OpenTelemetry collector, include batch and memory_limiter processors from the start and reuse existing Prometheus Kubernetes service discovery config. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 14:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=851s))

## Watch together (9 min)

1. [Cert-manager – Project Update: Beyond 2026 · 7:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzBGkY_HIyM&t=464s) (1:20), Tim Ramlot, Maël Valais: Ingress Nginx archive and cert-manager Gateway API implications.
2. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=1005s) (1:22), Regina Voloshin: ApplicationSets versus many individual Argo CD Applications.
3. [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 14:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=851s) (2:24), Yash Sharma, Kunju Perath: Practical Prometheus-to-OTel collector migration and processor lessons.
4. [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s) (1:21), Alfonso Ming, Jorge Turrado: Ambient mesh costs: Gateway API plugins, cert-manager, Argo Rollouts.
5. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 8:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=521s) (2:21), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Warns against using production Argo CD for PR previews.
